instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: The Spiral Model and Risk-Driven Development

questions.question: The Spiral Model was developed by...
questions.explanation: Barry Boehm published the spiral model in 1986 to bring risk analysis into the process.
questions.explanation_ar: نشر باري بوم النموذج الحلزوني عام 1986 ليدخل تحليل المخاطر في العملية.

questions.question: The project risk factor is considered in...
questions.question_ar: يُؤخذ عامل خطر المشروع بالحساب في...
questions.explanation: Each spiral loop starts with risk analysis, which is the model's defining step.
questions.explanation_ar: كل دورة في النموذج الحلزوني تبدأ بتحليل المخاطر، وهو خطوته المميزة.

questions.question: Which one is the most important feature of the Spiral model?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد هو أهم خصيصة في النموذج الحلزوني؟
questions.explanation: The spiral exists to analyse and reduce risk in every loop.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج الحلزوني موجود لتحليل المخاطر وتقليلها في كل دورة.

questions.question: Which four activities repeat in each spiral loop?
questions.question_ar: أي أربعة أنشطة تتكرر في كل دورة حلزونية؟
options: hire, train, build, retire now too now
design, code, test, deploy here here
options_en: hire, train, build, retire now too now
design, code, test, deploy here here
questions.explanation: Each loop sets objectives, analyses risk, develops the next level, then plans ahead.
questions.explanation_ar: كل دورة تحدد الأهداف وتحلّل المخاطر وتطوّر المستوى التالي ثم تخطط.

questions.question: What does each spiral loop begin with?
questions.explanation: Objectives for the next increment are fixed before any risk work starts.
questions.explanation_ar: أهداف الدفعة التالية تُحدَّد قبل أي عمل على المخاطر.

questions.question: After the increment is reviewed, what closes each loop?
questions.question_ar: بعد مراجعة الدفعة، ماذا يغلق كل دورة؟
options: a signed contract here too now here
the team disbanding now here too
review and planning of the next loop
a final product release again again
options_en: a signed contract here too now here
the team disbanding now here too
review and planning of the next loop
a final product release again again
options_ar: عقد موقّع هنا أيضاً الآن مجدداً
questions.explanation: The customer reviews the result and the next loop is planned from it.
questions.explanation_ar: العميل يراجع النتيجة وتُخطَّط الدورة التالية منها.

questions.question: For which projects is the spiral model best suited?
questions.question_ar: لأي مشاريع يناسب النموذج الحلزوني أكثر؟
questions.explanation: The risk loop pays off when the project is big enough for risk to matter.
questions.explanation_ar: دورة المخاطر تستحق عندما يكون المشروع كبيراً بحيث تهمّ المخاطر.

questions.question: What happens if risk analysis is skipped?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يحدث إذا أُهمل تحليل المخاطر؟
options: the project gets cheaper too now again
the loops disappear here again too
the model becomes agile now here
options_en: the project gets cheaper too now again
the loops disappear here again too
the model becomes agile now here
questions.explanation: Without the risk step the loop loses its purpose and behaves like a repeated waterfall.
questions.explanation_ar: بلا خطوة المخاطر تفقد الدورة هدفها وتتصرف كشلال متكرر.
